title: Brown's electrometers pick up anomalies matching the sidereal calendar, run up to the end of his life on Catalina

tellings.quote: One of the things he did was build these devices that he called electrometers and they were receiving maybe neutrinos.

plain: The inventor Thomas Townsend Brown is said to have built devices he called electrometers, which were picking up something, "maybe neutrinos." The readings showed oddities that followed sidereal time, which is time kept by the stars rather than the Sun, and he kept the work going on Catalina Island, California, until his death around 1985. Linda Brown tells this in a documentary on Brown made by Michels, passing on what Brown said and did. If true, it would mean his instruments were catching a signal from beyond the solar system.
